insights.summary: The agent performed a high-quality optimization task. It not only implemented the requested heuristic improvements but also identified and fixed a bug in the original code and added several micro-optimizations to the Triton kernel. Despite environment limitations (no GPU), it verified its work as much as possible.
strengths: Very strong understanding of Triton kernel logic
weaknesses: Initial tool usage error (Write before Read)
Large git commit included unrelated repo changes (though it correctly staged only the target file for the final commit)
